items.title: API gateway: bahut saari services ka ek front door
items.one_idea: An API gateway is the single entry point for clients in front of many services: it routes each request to the right service, can combine several service calls into one response, and handles shared edge jobs (authentication, throttling, logging) once; the price is one more moving part and one more network hop.
items.spoken_hook: Gateway पाँच calls को एक call बना देता है।
items.hook_formula: surprising_fact: composition, five client calls become one (the five is an EXAMPLE)
items.hook_10s: Gateway पाँच calls को एक call बना देता है। Example: app की एक screen को profile, orders, offers, cart, reviews चाहिए, पाँच services में। Gateway के बिना app पाँच बार network जाता है, gateway के साथ एक बार। [frame 0: phone sends one arrow into a box; the box fans it into five arrows to five service boxes and five answers merge back into one]

hook_candidates.text: Gateway पाँच calls को एक call बना देता है।
App को हर service का address याद रखना पड़े, तो क्या होगा?
Interviewer ने पूछा: API gateway reverse proxy से अलग कैसे है?

items.visual_idea: A phone on the left and 5 small service boxes on the right. First the phone draws 5 separate arrows (messy). Then a gateway box slides between: the phone has one arrow in, the gateway fans it out to the right service, and the answers fold back into one reply. A small row of 3 chips on the gateway (auth, throttle, log) lights up once as a request passes.
items.everyday_anchor: The reception desk of a big office building: you tell one desk who you want to meet, it checks your ID once, and sends you to the right floor, instead of every visitor wandering through every office.
items.example: EXAMPLE: a shopping app screen needs profile, orders, offers, cart and reviews, each in its own service. Five calls without a gateway, one call with it. The service names and the count five are invented.
facts_to_verify: microservices.io: the API gateway is the single entry point for all clients; it routes some requests to the right service and fans out others and combines the results; it can handle edge functions such as authentication; clients are shielded from how the app is split into services; fewer round trips, most useful for mobile; drawbacks: another moving part to develop, deploy and manage, and an extra network hop (latency).
AWS API Gateway docs: it acts as a 'front door' for applications to reach backend services; handles traffic management, authorization and access control, monitoring and API version management.
Wikipedia API management: a server acting as API front-end that receives API requests, enforces throttling and security policies, passes requests to the back-end service and returns the response.
NGINX reverse proxy guide: a reverse proxy forwards requests to other servers and is typically used to distribute load among several servers (used only for the one-beat contrast).
Our own reasoning, say it as reasoning and not as a sourced fact: a single gateway is a single point of failure unless run as several copies behind a load balancer. The sources do not state it.
Not claimed anywhere: any speed, cost or requests-per-second number, how a named company runs its gateway, that a gateway is built on a reverse proxy, JWT or OAuth details.

beats.show: phone with five arrows collapses into one arrow through a gateway box

beats.what: Problem in a person's words: 20 services behind the app; without a gateway the app must know every address, call each one, and each service must check login itself
beats.show: phone with many arrows to many boxes, each box with its own lock icon

beats.what: Definition: an API gateway is the single entry point for clients; the app talks only to it, and it talks to the services
beats.show: gateway box slides in, one arrow in, the many arrows now start from the gateway

beats.what: Job 1 routing: /orders goes to the orders service, /profile to the profile service
beats.show: two paths light up one at a time

beats.what: Job 2 composition: for one screen the gateway calls several services and merges the answers into one reply, so fewer round trips (EXAMPLE five to one)
beats.show: fan out, five answers fold back into one

beats.what: Job 3 edge jobs done once: authentication, throttling, logging at the door, not in every service
beats.show: three chips on the gateway, one lock replaces many

beats.what: Contrast in one beat: a reverse proxy mostly forwards requests to servers of the same app and spreads load; a gateway knows the API: which route, who may call it, how many calls, and can combine services
beats.show: left box 'forward', right box 'route + check + combine'

beats.what: Catch: one more moving part to run, one more network hop; and if the single gateway dies, every call dies, so run several copies behind a load balancer (our reasoning)
beats.show: gateway turns grey, all arrows stop; then three gateway copies behind a balancer

beats.what: Close: one front door for many services, with auth, throttling and routing at the door; the viewer can explain it in one sentence
